integrity: The lower bound is reconstructed from the explicit circle-action representation and the strict Eisenbud--Hirsch--Neumann criterion. The upper bound adapts the source monodromy-cover construction to a mixed boundary cycle type and uses the verified even-permutation factorization input. A bundled arithmetic checker verifies formulas and boundary cases but is not used as proof of the universal group-theoretic statements.
scientific_limitations: The result computes singular, not embedded, slope genus. It uses the special central-power structure, circle action, and covering construction of Nifa's exterior group; no analogous formula is claimed for arbitrary groups. Originality is assessed against inspected and indexed sources and retains the stated risk of an unindexed prior observation.
title: Complete singular-genus formula for Nifa's tangent slopes
